interface.longDescription: Infrastructure health and incident intelligence. Check 50 built-in vendors (GitHub, Cloudflare, OpenAI, AWS, GitLab, Slack, and more) across Atlassian Statuspage, Status.io, Slack, and AWS Health backends, inspect SSL/TLS certificates and DNS propagation for any domain, and get deterministic incident-response playbooks — all without API keys.
